description: The SPEC.md backlog: reschedule, reviews, reminders, and waitlists. Each needs its own spec + tests before building.

issues.title: Reschedule an appointment to another free slot
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §4 (was out of scope for v1). Write the spec section + tests first.

## Task
Add `POST /api/appointments/:id/reschedule` moving a booking to another free slot in one transaction (old slot frees, new slot reserved).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Only the owning customer can reschedule (403 otherwise).
- [ ] New slot must be valid + free; otherwise 409, and the original stays intact.
- [ ] Same 24h rule as cancel applies.
- [ ] Tests cover ownership, the 24h rule, and the atomic move.

issues.title: Reviews & ratings for completed appointments
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §4 backlog.

## Task
Let a customer leave a 1–5 rating + comment on a past, completed appointment; show the service's average rating.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One review per appointment, by the customer who booked it only.
- [ ] Rating constrained to 1..5 (Zod); comment length-limited.
- [ ] Service detail shows average rating + count.
- [ ] Tests cover the one-review rule + rating bounds.

issues.title: Appointment reminders (email/SMS abstraction)
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §4 backlog. Use a provider abstraction so the demo runs without a real sender.

## Task
Send a reminder 24h before an appointment via an injectable notifier (email now; SMS behind the same interface).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A scheduled job selects appointments ~24h out and notifies once.
- [ ] Notifier is injectable and faked in tests (asserted, not really sent).
- [ ] Idempotent: a reminder is never sent twice for the same appointment.
- [ ] No PII in logs.

issues.title: Waitlist for fully-booked slots
issues.body:
## Context
Source: SPEC.md §4 backlog.

## Task
Let a customer join a waitlist for a taken slot; when it frees (cancel/reschedule), notify the first person in line.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Customer can join/leave a waitlist for a specific slot.
- [ ] On a slot freeing, the first waitlisted customer is notified.
- [ ] No double-notify; leaving the waitlist removes them from the queue.
- [ ] Tests cover FIFO order + the free-slot trigger.
